{{Money|600}} (Group Bonus) |time = 18:00 |rewards = {{Coins|600}}, {{Exp|120}} & {{TowerExp|75}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For players who are familiar with the game and want a balanced experience.|Description in Elevators}} {{QuoteBox|For players who are experienced with the game and want a little challenge.|Former Description in Elevators}} }} ==Description== '''Intermediate''' mode is one of the six main survival modes. It has 30 waves, and the final boss is [[Patient Zero]]. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this mode's [[Intermediate Mode/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|500}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only) |{{Exp|120}} ÷ (1 + [(30 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) |{{TowerExp|35}} ÷ (1 + [(25 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|40}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Intermediate''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (65%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} **[[Grenade]] (1-3) **[[Flash Bang]] (1-3) **[[Molotov]] (1-3) **[[Easter Egg]] (1-3) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (20%) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} **[[Barricade]] (1-2) **[[Supply Drop]] (1-2) **[[AirStrike]] (1-2) **[[Ducky Squad]] (1-2) *{{Color|Rare}} (10%) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Napalm Strike]] **[[Blizzard Bomb]] **[[UAV]] *{{Color|Legendary}} (5%) **[[High Grade Crate]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeated Patient Zero! |description = Destroy the apocalypse from its roots! You have defeated Intermediate mode! |image = Aug25IntermediateBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Battle Hardened |description = Triumph in Intermediate mode |image = Achievement |obtainable = Yes |rewards = {{Coins|250}} }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Intermediate''' mode could give currency rewards which you used to progress through a season. Rewards for all the seasons were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Season !Rewards |- |[[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]] |{{Bell|10}} per wave |- |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]] |{{DuckyEggs|10}} per wave |- |[[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] |{{BeachBalls|10}} per wave |- |[[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] |{{GumDrops|10}} per wave |- |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] |{{PlushieSnowman|10}} per wave |- |[[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] |{{Bunz|10}} per wave |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:80%; margin:1em auto" |[[File:{{#choose:NormalAnim1.png|NormalAnim2.png|NormalAnim3.png}}|center|150px|link=Normal]] |[[File:SpeedyAnim2.png|center|150px|link=Speedy]] |[[File:{{#choose:SlowAnim1.png|SlowAnim2.png}}|center|150px|link=Slow]] |[[File:EasyModeNormalBoss.png|center|150px|link=Normal Boss]] |- |[[Normal]]

1 Total |} ==Wave Structure== In '''Intermediate''' mode, the formula for calculating the wave bonus on each wave is: :{{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|150}} Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |6% |12% |- |Trio |7% |21% |- |Quad |6% |24% |} Prior to the 11th of September 2024, the formula for calculating the wave bonus depended on the wave. They were: *Between Waves 1-10 and on Wave 30: *:({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|150}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) *Between Waves 11-20 and on Wave 30: *:({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|200}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) *Between Waves 21-28 and on Wave 30: *:({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|350}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) *On Wave 29: *:{{Money|15,000}} ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 20%. The waves in '''Intermediate''' mode follow these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-29 |1:00 |0:19Skip at 0:40. |- |30 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. There is a total of 1,483 enemies in '''Intermediate''' mode, excluding uncountable summoned enemies from [[Patient Zero]]. For former wave structures of '''Intermediate''' mode, visit the [[Intermediate Mode/Waves|Waves]] page.
